entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: A daruma... I used to make wishes on[n]these.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: When my wish came true, I filled in the[n]second eye. How many years has it been[n]since the last time I was able to do that?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: "Politician Formerly of the Kuramoto[n]Children Reflects on Past Mistakes"...[n]How's that sound?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Come now, there's no need for all that.[n]It's true that I have no intention of[n]repeating my mistakes, though.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'm going to walk the path I believe in.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, how come this daruma only has[n]one eye?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, you know. It's just, uh... they forgot!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: When you make a wish, you paint in the[n]left eye. Then, when that wish comes[n]true, you add in the right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, yeah, that!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...You had no idea, did you?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was really surprised when I turned into[n]a mouse.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In Shido's eyes, anyone who dared to[n]oppose him was as insignificant as[n]vermin...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I imagine that was more or less the[n]reasoning.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That means... If Shido thought of us[n]as octopi, that's what we would have[n]turned into?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hmm, by that logic, yes. That would[n]have been a valuable experience in its[n]own right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: When I remember that Shido could[n]have ended up as the prime minister...[n]It's a horrifying thought.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Not only that, but the public actually[n]WANTED to vote for him. It's kinda[n]crazy...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No kiddin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell, even I woulda done a better job[n]runnin' the country than that asshole.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I think that scenario would have[n]presented its own set of problems.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Agreed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I know...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: The name "daruma" comes from the[n]Buddhist monk Bodhidharma, founder[n]of Zen Buddhism.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wow... So it's based on a real person.[n]But why is it just a floating head?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, the prevailing theory is that the[n]Buddha's years of sitting cross-legged[n]eventually caused the limbs to rot away...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Sorry. I'm getting into teacher mode,[n]aren't I?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's okay. It's interesting!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Now, if only you paid this much[n]attention during class.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...And without nodding off, hm?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ahaha... Sorry.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: What a nice-looking daruma. I feel like I[n]should make a wish on it before a meet...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A wish, huh? Maybe I'll make one too.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: May as well. Wishes are free, after all.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: What are you two going to wish for?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I wish to win a raffle to let me buy a[n]limited-edition figure!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wish for the supermarket to expand its[n]free sample section!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wow... You're both so creative!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The other passengers on that ship were[n]unsavory people too, weren't they?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Especially those five VIPs.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: From what we heard, they actually exist[n]in the real world... They weren't just a[n]figment of Shido's cognition.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I guess evil breeds more evil. I wonder[n]if those people are still out there, exactly[n]as they were...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: At the very least, they've lost the support[n]of Shido. I'm certain their influence has[n]diminished greatly after that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I would not say our efforts were in vain.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes... You're right.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah... That's the thing that turned[n]us into mice.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: While I appreciated the new experience,[n]the freedom of action certainly left[n]something to be desired.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maybe now you can finally understand[n]how difficult my life is.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Totally.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I used to think you had it made, just[n]sitting around in a bag not having to[n]lift a paw... Sorry, Morgana.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That wounds me, Lady Ann...
